title: Lenia Creatures
blurb: Bert Chan's continuous cellular automaton on the GPU: Orbium gliders swim through iridescent potential halos leaving rainbow light-trails, or switch to a Hydrogeminium colony or a writhing two-ring tissue.
controls: Click or drag to drop creatures (drag aims them), pick a species, sliders for growth mu, width sigma, time step, speed and trails; Reseed, Clear, Pause, Record; H hides UI, R records, Space reseeds
tech: WebGL2 fragment shaders, direct ring-kernel convolution
